readme: CANONICAL store registry (2026-07-26, estate-audit item #5). One row per store the board tracks. Scripts that need the full store list read THIS file (sorted by 'order'); audit-store-registry.ps1 scans live scripts daily and flags any hardcoded list that names >=3 stores but not all of them (the publish-store-guide/publish-deals-page Fareway-drift class). Add a new store HERE FIRST, then run audit-store-registry.ps1 to find every site the change must reach. 'allowed_subsets' documents lines that legitimately name only some stores. 'walled': true marks the four stores whose prices can only be captured through a human browser session behind a bot wall (Walmart, Sam's Club, Aldi, Fareway) - build-rescue-worklist.ps1 reads THIS FLAG to decide which stores get a rescue term list. It is an explicit flag and not a match on 'capture' on purpose: Aldi's capture string starts with 'server (Flipp flyerkit JSON)' because its AD is a server pull, while its shelf prices come off the Instacart storefront by hand, so any substring test for 'browser' silently drops it.
